description: Commission of Elections - Declare that Y. M. Somarathne as a member of the Panduwasnuwara Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Panduwasnuwara Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of an elected member. It involves the electoral process under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, including the nomination and declaration of a new member by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
